messages:
maria: Kicking off rollout for release/2026.3.4 -> canary 5% now.
deploy-bot: started rollout release/2026.3.4 canary=5% (hosts: svc-embed-a, svc-gen-b)
ryan: pulling up SLO dashboard and traces, watching p95, 5xx, and kvcache metrics
sre-bot: SLO check: p95_gen = 210ms baseline -> current 236ms (+12%), 5xx_rate = 0.35% (threshold 0.5%)
lee: noticing a small 5xx cluster from embed-service in eu-west-1
maria: is that limited to canaries or bleeding to steady-state? run a synthetic against canary
olivia: ran `curl -I https://canary.gen.redwood/v1/generate` -> 200 but observed `X-Model-Variant: v2-quant` in headers; app logs show intermittent 429s from kvcache on node-03
ryan: initiating synthetic load (5rps) against canary health + /generate to replicate
sre-bot: metric alert: kvcache_miss_rate{node="node-03"} = 18% (baseline ~3%)
tessa: @maria I'm leaning to pause until we confirm kvcache isn't thrashing. :thinking_face:
maria: pausing rollout now. deploy-bot: pause
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 5% canary
maria: quick tail of problematic logs (top lines):
```
2026-03-17T14:12:05Z node-03 kvcache: eviction-threshold exceeded
2026-03-17T14:12:07Z node-03 runtime: tensor_alloc retry (OOM backoff)
2026-03-17T14:12:08Z node-03 http: 429 generated (kvcache over-capacity)
```
ryan: looks like GC/eviction on node-03 caused cache churn -> higher cold misses -> backend slowdown. Suggest temporary mitigation: reduce batching on canary nodes and disable continuous batching for the affected pool.
lee: preparing hotfix build 2026.3.4-hotfix1: changes -> kvcache GC tuning + batch cap=8
olivia: can we validate hotfix in isolated canary-only pool before resuming? I can spin synthetic probes and monitor 3 region windows
maria: yes run isolated canary + smoke checks. If any region sees p95 > 300ms or 5xx > 0.6% -> rollback.
tessa: documenting decision in release notes and annotating runbook. will add links.
deploy-bot: started hotfix rollout 2026.3.4-hotfix1 -> canary-isolated
sre-bot: smoke checks running: generate p95 -> 205ms, error_rate -> 0.12% after hotfix applied
olivia: proposing ramp plan: 5% -> 10% -> 25% with 10m hold at each step, monitor p95 and error budget across regions
maria: ack. hard stop criteria: p95 > 300ms OR regional 5xx > 0.6% -> immediate rollback, else continue ramp.
lee: filed INF-2141 to investigate node-03 eviction pattern and GC heuristics
ryan: I'm watching traces; tail-latency normalized after GC tweak. will keep synthetic running and dump flamegraphs if it regresses
maria: unpause and advance to 10% now
deploy-bot: rolled to 10% canary
ryan: observing p95 210ms, 5xx 0.08% across canary -> holding at 10%
maria: leaving thread open until full ramp. added change-window note and will update calendar invite.
tessa: release notes updated and linked to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-kvcache
olivia: mapped alert rule -> runbook mapping and assigned oncall
sre-bot: final roll check: error_budget remaining (product-team) = 72%
maria: thanks team, great quick coordination. will post a short deploy blurb in #eng-releases once to 100% :tada:
